title: cse-coach Pattern Sense weekly deck contract
description: The weekly recognition deck emitted by scripts/pattern_sense.py from dashboard/pattern_sense.yml and techniques.yml, consumed by the progressiveoverflow.com Pattern Sense 'This week' tab. `families` is sorted by id and each `techniques` list is in techniques.yml order: these arrays are the chip order, and a 1-based index in the results code (`PS1 <week> <vocabHash> <n>:<f>/<t> ...`) indexes `families` (step 1) or the correct family's `techniques` (step 2). `vocabHash` is the first 6 hex chars of sha256 over the lines `id:tech|tech` joined by newlines. With no deck, `week` is null and `problems` is empty. No slug, title, URL or tag is ever present: a title spoils the technique.

week.description: The deck's Monday, or null when no deck exists.
